title: three days to 28
text:
today i was contemplating turning 28…

i'm three days away from 28. it's a… scratch that, it's always a nice time for consumer app founders to be born… in september. you always have spikes and a shit ton of users come in… happens every year…

this year too, shit's going off… this year i feel… i've grown a ton…

i used to think being old and a founder means you're losing sight of trends, out of the loop, and don't know what you're doing. but i don't think that's necessarily true…

i think what happens is at a certain age you feel like you know everything and you stop learning… i have never felt that. i always feel like there's room to grow… i'm still hungry, but it's a different kind of hunger… it's no longer a toxic hunger to work till i drop or shit like that… it's much more calculated, precise, and to the point…

i feel this year has been a year of defeating a lot of shit… i think the biggest lesson i take away is execute with confidence… not in ignorance… people don't realize how hard it is to do that… i've learnt to trust my gut and it has been the best blessing ever. i realized that i am right, i just never fought hard enough for my thoughts…

i've never felt so free but also never felt more responsible… the thing about decisions is if you never truly own it, you never truly feel it…

time gives you a reason to say it's not you, it's whatever else… it takes a certain courage and belief in yourself to own the decision and take it all the way. that's what i've learnt today and this year, and i'm grateful.

title: hello
text:
this is the first entry in the journal.

i wanted a place that is mine. not a feed, not a profile, not a pitch. just a page where i can write down what i am thinking about while building things.

most of what shows up here will be about Penseum: what we are trying, what is working, what is not. some of it will be about everything around the work. reading, walking, the small decisions that end up mattering more than the big ones.

the site itself is deliberately simple. big type, small type, a journal. it should load fast and get out of the way.

if you want to follow along, the links are at the bottom of the home page.
textHi:
यह डायरी की पहली प्रविष्टि है।

मुझे एक ऐसी जगह चाहिए थी जो मेरी हो। न फ़ीड, न प्रोफ़ाइल, न पिच। बस एक पन्ना जहाँ मैं लिख सकूँ कि चीज़ें बनाते हुए मैं क्या सोच रहा हूँ।

यहाँ ज़्यादातर बातें Penseum के बारे में होंगी: हम क्या आज़मा रहे हैं, क्या काम कर रहा है, क्या नहीं। कुछ बातें काम के आसपास की हर चीज़ के बारे में होंगी।

साइट जानबूझकर सादी है। बड़े अक्षर, छोटे अक्षर, एक डायरी।
